_note: Story portraits (tools/gen_story.py; docs/story.md 'Portraits'). Per speaker: 'art' = an approved portrait-v2 source (assets/story/portraits/<name>.txt: colour keys with their DMG shade, @size up to 56x56, @maxpal <= 3, an 'obj=' key = a CGB-only OBJ accent; the CGB BG palettes, the per-tile palette map and the overlay come from the art itself, converted exactly or the build fails), or none for a generated placeholder (a framed 32x32 silhouette with the name, 'tint' its CGB palette, 'label' the name it shows); 'x', 'y' = screen tile of the picture's top-left (the frame takes one tile around it; default: column 2, the frame's bottom on row 12; a picture whose bottom row is 12 stands on the text box, whose top panel is then the frame's bottom). The old repo format still works for 'art': '.-+#' = colours 0-3, with 'palettes' (CGB BG, #rrggbb x4, 1-3: slots 2-4), 'attr' (a palette digit per tile) and 'overlay' {art (8x16 cells), x, y (px from the picture), palettes (CGB OBJ slots 3, 4, 6, 7), dmg_obp 0/1}. NARRATOR has no portrait.
